### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the negative-timespan formatting fix. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes negative timespan literals in KQL builders and query parameters, complementing the `Timespan.Marshal` fix in #285. **Changes:** - Emits one leading minus sign and preserves the day component, safely handling the minimum Go duration. - Retains 100 ns precision and adds regression tests for multi-day, fractional-second, and minimum-duration values through both APIs. - Documents the fix in the changelog. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `CHANGELOG.md` | Records the negative-timespan formatting fix. | | `azkustodata/​kql/​string_utils.go` | Formats the sign and duration magnitude using integer arithmetic. | | `azkustodata/​kql/​query_parameters_test.go` | Adds regression coverage for query parameters and the KQL builder. |
Review effort: Max
